avoid_when: Avoid when the opening page needs imagery, branding, or a detailed abstract.
Avoid for regular content slides or information-dense layouts.
families.description: A minimalist formal cover centers the presentation title in a blue band, followed by presenter details and a date.
families.digest: cover with title band and presenter details
families.name: cover-hero
selection_hints: Use as an opening cover for a formal interview, proposal, or internal presentation.
Choose when the title, presenter details, and date are the only required information.

avoid_when: Avoid when detailed conclusions, next steps, or contact information must be presented.
Avoid when the closing slide needs imagery, branding, or multiple content sections.
families.description: A minimalist closing page uses one oversized centered text block and ample white space to end the presentation clearly.
families.name: closing-hero
selection_hints: Use as a simple final slide after the presentation content.
Choose when a prominent two-line closing or thank-you message is sufficient.

avoid_when: Avoid when the content has no supporting visual.
Avoid when several parallel sections or data views are required.
Avoid when the visual and text need unequal emphasis.
families.description: A broad heading introduces a balanced two-column layout with a large explanatory visual on the left and descriptive prose on the right.
families.digest: title with diagram and explanatory text
families.name: content-split
selection_hints: Use for explaining one concept with a supporting visual.
Use when an image or diagram and a moderate paragraph should receive balanced space.
Use for educational, technical, biographical, or case-study content with one main illustration.

avoid_when: Avoid when the content is primarily visual or image-led.
Avoid when there is no structured data suitable for a table.
Avoid when detailed commentary requires multiple separate text sections.
families.description: A prominent header introduces a large multi-column table, followed by a rounded callout that highlights the main takeaway.
families.digest: large data table with takeaway callout
families.name: content-title_body
selection_hints: Use for presenting a substantial matrix or structured dataset.
Use when a table needs a clearly highlighted takeaway beneath it.
Use for evidence-led content with one concise interpretation.

avoid_when: Avoid when the content needs charts, imagery, or side-by-side comparison.
Avoid when presenting more than one distinct content block.
families.description: A conventional content slide pairs a prominent blue title band with one large, left-aligned bullet-list area.
families.digest: title band over single bullet list
families.name: content-title_body
selection_hints: Use for a straightforward topic explanation organized as several bullet points.
Choose when one bullet may require a longer supporting description.

avoid_when: Avoid when the agenda needs descriptions, timings, or multiple hierarchy levels.
Avoid when a visual roadmap or highly designed section navigation is required.
families.description: A clean agenda page places a prominent title in a colored header above a spacious numbered section list.
families.digest: simple agenda with numbered topic list
families.name: agenda-title_body
selection_hints: Use for a straightforward table of contents with a short list of sections.
Best for approximately four to six concise agenda items.
